queries_run: Coinbase antitrust OR DOJ OR FTC OR regulatory scrutiny 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露：Coinbase 已收到多個州機關與檢察長、各監管機構的調查傳票與要求函，涉及上架流程、資產分類、質押計畫、穩定幣與收益產品；公司表示將配合。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: we have received investigative subpoenas and demand letters from various regulators for documents and information, including about certain customer programs, operations, and existing and intended future products, including our processes for listing assets, the classification of certain listed assets, our staking programs, and our stablecoin and yield-generating products.

findings.claim: 2026-04 Bloomberg 報導：CFTC 表示因 Coinbase 與 Gemini 相關行動而起訴紐約州（州與聯邦監管權限之爭）。細節未讀到。
findings.excerpt: CFTC says it has sued New York in response to Coinbase (COIN) and Gemini actions, Bloomberg reports.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見 2026 年 DOJ／FTC 對 Coinbase 的反壟斷調查；僅見私人反壟斷訴訟（BiT Global 10 億美元案，2025-05 法官傾向駁回）。
findings.source: Law360, Coinbase May Avoid BiT Global's $1B Antitrust Suit, For Now
findings.excerpt: A California federal judge indicated Thursday she'll likely toss a $1 billion antitrust case against Coinbase claiming the cryptocurrency exchange delisted BiT Global after launching a competing
